sentences.text:
Applicant :- Wasim And 6 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Satyam Narayan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- Rajesh Mishra,G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.
List revised.
None appears on behalf of opposite party no.2.

2. Heard Mr. Satyam Narayan, learned counsel for the applicants as well as Ms. Kirti Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 18.06.2023 along with Cognizance order dated 18.08.2023 and the entire proceeding of Case No.21176 of 2023,
arising out of Case Crime No.161 of 2023 (State vs. Wasim and Others), under Sections 498A, 323,
354 I.P.C., Section 3/4 D.P. Act and 3/4 The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act,
Wasim And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99928904/
1 Police Station- Lisarigate, District- Meerut as well as stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case, pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut, on the basis of compromise.
4.

sentences.text:
On 01.10.2024, the following order was passed :-
"Sri Rajesh Mishra, Advocate filed vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party no. 2 which is taken on record.
Office is directed to show the name of Sri Rajesh Mishra, in the appropriate column of counsel in the next cause list.

Learned counsel for both the parties submitted that parties settled their dispute arising out of offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, on the basis of compromise dated 9.1.2024.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Certified copy of compromise is annexed at Annexure-3 to the affidavit.
Office is directed to send certified copy of compromise to court concerned for verification immediately after retaining a photocopy of the same.
Both the parties are directed to appear before the court concerned within three weeks from today.
Court concerned is directed to verify the same.
Applicants are directed to file supplementary affidavit annexing certified copy of the compromise as well as proceedings of verification of compromise.
Put up this case on 26.11.2024, as fresh.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Case No. 21176 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No. 161 of 2023, under Sections 498-A, 323, 354 of I.P.C., Section 3/4 of D.P. Act and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage)
Act, P.S. Lisarigate, District Meerut, pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut, shall remain stayed against the applicants."
5.

Act

sentences.text: The compromise verification report is awaited as is evident from office report dated 08.01.2025.

6. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that in compliance of earlier order of this Court the parties could not appear before the Court below for verification of compromise within stipulated period as directed by this Court due to reasons best known to them.
Therefore, in the interest of justice, some time may be granted to the parties to appear before the Court below in compliance of order dated 01.10.2024 passed by this Court.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the aforesaid.

8. In view of the above, both the parties are directed to appear before the court below along with the certified copy of this order and be permitted to file a proper compromise deed as well as an application for verification of the same.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise and after ensuring the presence of parties, pass an appropriate order with respect to the same in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of two months from today.

While passing the order verifying the compromise, the concerned court shall also record the statements of the parties as to whether all the terms and conditions mentioned in the original compromise deed, so filed, have been fulfilled or not.

9. The court in that scenario will allow the parties to obtain certified copy of the order verifying the compromise deed and it will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
10. Till verification of compromise between the parties by the court concerned, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
11. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.
Order Date :- 9.1.2025
